name: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B
description: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is the open-weight checkpoint of Qwen3.8-Max: a text-only Mixture-of-Experts model with 2.4 trillion total parameters and 95 billion active parameters. Thinking is always on. Native context length is 262,144 tokens, extensible to about 1 million. Weights are released under the Qwen3.8-Max License (commercial and MaaS thresholds) on Hugging Face and ModelScope. Distinct from the hosted multimodal API id qwen3.8-max on QwenCloud.
